discovery.source_role: DISCOVERY_ONLY; formal trade decision remains MASTER-owned

selection_contract.prefilter: single broad cross-section; minimum executability; explicit information-acquisition classes for relative divergence, structural change, short-history current change and persistent structure; exact cheap-label clone control; no return ranking; date hash is tie-break only within equivalent information class/exposure
selection_contract.final_ingress: history budget counts successful evidence acquisition, with a bounded attempt cap; provider failure is explicit, does not consume a successful-evidence seat, and does not convert successful peers into legal capital competitors

discovery.decision_boundary: 发现对象是本节点临时正式评估输入，不是第三种ETF身份；不得自动写观察池、生成Trial/Confirm或交易动作。

consumption_rule: Formal Decision and downstream reviews consume the latest same-node legal Discovery; failure is explicit and never converted to zero candidates.
identity_boundary: This current-pulse artifact is a discovery input only; it does not establish Observation, opportunity, Trial, Confirm, amount, sell quantity or order.
